You will compare one known error in a data agent's work against a ranked list of items produced by a reviewer. Your job is to decide whether any item in the list identifies this known error, and if so, which one.

An item identifies the known error only if both of these hold:
- It is about the same thing: the same table, and the same column, computation, filter, or join.
- It points to the same problem: what the item says is wrong, assumed, or missing is the same as what went wrong in the known error. It does not matter whether the item is phrased as an assumption the agent made ("the agent assumes ...") or as a problem in the work ("this does not match ..."); judge by meaning.

An item does not count if it only says that something may be wrong without saying what, such as "this column may be computed incorrectly". An item about the same column but a different problem does not count.

If more than one item identifies the error, report the highest-ranked one. If you are unsure, say so rather than guessing.

Return a JSON object with:
- "verdict": "match", "no_match", or "unsure".
- "rank": the position of the matching item (1 is the top), or null.
- "quote": the exact words from the matching item that show it identifies the error, or null.
- "reason": one short sentence.

=== Known error ===
Table: int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis
What the agent's work assumed: avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate 用全部历史日期求平均就行
What was actually required or true: 只平均今天往前 30 天以内（含）的日期

=== Reviewer's ranked list for this table ===
[
  {
    "rank": 1,
    "item": {
      "statement": "General-event page IDs, positive event counts, and minutes of at least one are sufficient substitutes for the three specified event sources and their presence flags.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "intermediate.int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "FROM staging.stg_pendo__event; CASE WHEN num_events>0 THEN visitor_id END; CASE WHEN num_minutes>=1 THEN visitor_id END",
      "alternative": "The contract requires a union of general events as page_view, feature events as feature_click, and page events as page_interaction, with presence flags based on whether each event type exists.",
      "reason": "The substitution changes the visitor population and every conversion numerator and denominator.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c10-1",
      "call": 10
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 2,
    "item": {
      "statement": "The funnel model may leave all visitor-average and session-quality metrics null rather than computing them.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "intermediate.int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "NULL::DOUBLE avg_engagement_score,NULL::DOUBLE avg_pages_per_visitor,NULL::DOUBLE avg_features_per_user,NULL::FLOAT high_quality_session_rate,NULL::FLOAT bounce_rate",
      "alternative": "The contract requires visitor-level distinct entities, weighted engagement scores, session-quality classifications, and their account-level averages and rates.",
      "reason": "Five required analytical outputs are missing independently of source data.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c10-9",
      "call": 10
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 3,
    "item": {
      "statement": "Averages over all available daily rows are acceptable as the funnel model's 30-day cohort averages.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "intermediate.int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis.avg_30d_page_to_feature_rate, avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate, avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "avg(overall_conversion_rate) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,app_id) avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate",
      "alternative": "The contract limits these averages to \"dates on or after 30 days before today\" with an inclusive lower bound.",
      "reason": "Older activity can materially change every reported cohort average.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c10-10",
      "call": 10
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 4,
    "item": {
      "statement": "The funnel model may assign the same health rating and optimization recommendation to every daily row.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "intermediate.int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis.funnel_health_rating, optimization_recommendation",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "'Poor' funnel_health_rating,'Focus on feature discovery and onboarding' optimization_recommendation",
      "alternative": "The contract requires health thresholds on the 30-day overall rate and ordered recommendation rules using page-to-feature, feature-to-deep, and bounce averages.",
      "reason": "The prescribed business classifications are disconnected from the computed rates.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c10-11",
      "call": 10
    }
  },
  {
    "rank": 5,
    "item": {
      "statement": "The funnel conversion trend may always be null without comparing the specified recent and preceding windows.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "intermediate.int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis.conversion_rate_trend",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "NULL::DOUBLE conversion_rate_trend",
      "alternative": "The contract requires the average overall rate from seven days ago onward minus the average from thirty to seven days ago, including the seven-days-ago date in both windows.",
      "reason": "The output cannot indicate improvement or deterioration even when both windows contain data.",
      "updates": null,
      "id": "c10-15",
      "call": 10
    }
  }
]
